ConnectionStrings.//: Placeholder matches the docker-compose Postgres (port 5433). For Supabase, put the Session-pooler connection string in the gitignored appsettings.Development.local.json (or user-secrets) — do NOT commit it here. On Render set the ConnectionStrings__Default env var.

Gemini.//: AI rehearsal-schedule suggestions (and formations later). Create a free API key at Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com) and set it via Gemini__ApiKey env var (Render) or appsettings.Development.local.json / user-secrets locally — do NOT commit a real key here. Left blank, /api/rehearsals/suggest reports configured:false and the UI hides the feature. Model defaults to gemini-flash-lite-latest.

Email.//: Outbound email (rehearsal schedules + team invites) via Gmail SMTP. GmailUser = the sending Gmail address; GmailAppPassword = a 16-char App Password (Google Account -> Security -> App passwords, requires 2-Step Verification) — NOT the account password. Set via Email__GmailUser / Email__GmailAppPassword env vars (Render) or appsettings.Development.local.json locally — do NOT commit real values here. Left blank, the Send buttons are disabled and invites fall back to copying the code. AppUrl = the client origin used in invite emails.

Clerk.//: From your Clerk application. Authority = the Frontend API / Issuer URL, e.g. https://your-app.clerk.accounts.dev — set it in appsettings.Development.local.json locally or Clerk__Authority on Render. AuthorizedParty = your app origin (http://localhost:5201 in dev). Left blank, the API runs UNAUTHENTICATED (local dev convenience).
